DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_alarm_condition_alarm_id as "id", incident_alarm_condition_id as "incidentAlarmConditionId", incident_alarm_condition_alarm_type_id as "incidentAlarmConditionAlarmTypeId", alarm_config_id as "alarmConfigId", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_id as "elementId", min_alarmed_elements as "minAlarmedElements", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.ims_incident_alarm_condition_alarms WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.ims_incident_alarm_condition_alarms (incident_alarm_condition_alarm_id, incident_alarm_condition_id, incident_alarm_condition_alarm_type_id, alarm_config_id, element_type_id, element_id, min_alarmed_elements, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextId{'conf.ims_incident_alarm_condition_alarms'$'incident_alarm_condition_alarm_id'}, :incidentAlarmConditionId, :incidentAlarmConditionAlarmTypeId, :alarmConfigId, :elementTypeId, :elementId, :minAlarmedElements, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.ims_incident_alarm_condition_alarms SET incident_alarm_condition_id = :incidentAlarmConditionId, incident_alarm_condition_alarm_type_id = :incidentAlarmConditionAlarmTypeId, alarm_config_id = :alarmConfigId, element_type_id = :elementTypeId, element_id = :elementId, min_alarmed_elements = :minAlarmedElements, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE incident_alarm_condition_alarm_id = :id
